messages:
Dan (Sales): Heads-up: Orion Robotics wants a special onboarding discount to sign a 12mo Dedicated contract. They want 20% off months 1-2 and Net45.
Maya (Revenue Ops): Send raw ask (list price, size). We'll need finance + legal.
Dan (Sales): 4x A100-eq, list $80k/mo. Ask: 20% months 1-2 = $32k credit; Net45; price protection for 3 months.
Nina (Customer Success): Orion needs migration help and an SLA onboarding window. We'll allocate 15 engineer-hours in month 1. Add cost to model.
Omar (Finance): Net45 + big credit is cash-risky. What's precedent? Last concession over 15% required addendum and deposit.
Dan (Sales): They say competitor offered 18% and faster onboarding. Close probability jumps if we match 20%.
Maya (Revenue Ops): Options: a) 20% x2, Net30, 1-mo deposit, concession addendum with clawback; b) 12% x2, Net30, no deposit.
Priya (CFO): I prefer Net30. Approve up to 15% with deposit. 20% only if NPV impact < $25k and Legal signs clawback clause.
LegalBot: Auto: concession >15% needs addendum. Recommend clawback: if consumption < 60% of projected in first 60d, Redwood may invoice difference. No price-protection language.
Omar (Finance): Quick calc: 20% x2 = $32k one-time; NPV over 12mo at 8% ~= $29k. Slightly above threshold. 15% x2 NPV ~= $21.8k.
Dan (Sales): Customer pushing for 20% + Net45. If we offer 15% + Net30 + deposit, they'll likely accept.
Maya (Revenue Ops): Drafting addendum now with clawback text. Will share by 3pm.
Priya (CFO): Decision: Approve 15% for months 1-2, Net30, 1-month security deposit, and concession addendum with clawback. If Dan can get exec confirmation that 20% is must-have, re-open with Marcus and Legal.
Dan (Sales): Got it. I'll propose the 15% package. If they push, will escalate. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
